description: Reverse lookup: the controls that address an item of a standard, with strength (direct or partial) and confidence. A ref that is a prefix (for example 6.1) returns every item under it.

ref.description: Item in that standard, for example 6.1.2, A.6.2.3, Art. 14 or LLM01:2026

standard.description: Standard key or name, for example ISO42001, 'ISO/IEC 42001', EUAIA, OWASPLLM

name: get_mapping
title: Which controls cover a standard's item
